title: Event
description: Append-only record of a state change. Authoritative source of truth for actor activity. Materialized fields on Task (status, assignee_id, claim_holder_id, claim_expires_at) are projections of these events. Events MUST NOT be mutated or deleted.

actor_id.description: The actor who performed the action. For agents this is the agent's actor id, NOT parent_actor_id.

kind.description: Event taxonomy is FIXED in v0.x. New event kinds require a protocol minor-version bump. Existing `assigned` events are reused for both normal assignment and claim-lease transitions; claim-lease events are identified by `payload.claim_expires_at`.

payload.description: Event-specific payload. Conventions: created → {title, status}; status_changed → {from, to}; assigned → {from, to} (actor_ids or nulls). For normal assignment events, `assigned` projects to assignee_id and omits claim lease metadata. For claim-lease events, `assigned` MUST include `claim_expires_at` and projects only to claim_holder_id and claim_expires_at; `payload.from`/`payload.to` still carry the actor transition. context_updated → free-form context delta; commented → {body}. Implementations MAY include additional fields.

operation_id.description: The idempotency key the verb call used. The same operation_id never produces two events.
